description: A new function from its doc comment: two parallel reads, the body edited in under the comment (non-ASCII in new_string), the export added.
prompt: Implement slugify in src/slug.js as its comment describes (accents are removed: "Crème brûlée" gives "creme-brulee"), and export it from src/index.js.

deliberate.why: marv-rs refuses edit_file and write_file on an existing file the session hasn't read, or that changed since it read it: the scripted model also reads `src/index.js` before editing (script.marv-rs.jsonl), and nothing else changes. The files and exit code are Marv's.
